operator.decision: At the sole historical failing incidence, require abs(error)+4 SE <= margin for each of four known cosine-weighted integrals from the actual returned proposal PDF, and for each difference between accepted raw direction moments [1,x,y,z] and independent uniform-solid-angle Sobol integration of the reported PDF. Use combined independent standard error. All A/C support, finite nonnegative response and historical WL83 sample-vs-recomputed-PDF and WL104F weight identity checks must pass. Preserve the old audit and its limit. No extra seed runs.

fit.meaning: R0 is frozen ER_DF. R1 uses the original WL82 metric el1+ealb. R2 is the exact WL104F normalized F-squared recipe. Run the same matched A/C starts for both objectives on the original 64x64 per-material fit lanes. Use all nine frozen WL104D rows for paired angular and held-out distribution evidence. Fit each material independently. No independent reference or render values in training or selection.
fit.f_squared: For each incident group, sum use/q * (F_cl-F_layered)^2 over outgoing lanes and RGB, divide by the sum use/q * F_layered^2 over the same lanes and channels, then average equal incidence groups. F is the native cosine-weighted eval, with no extra cosine factor.
fit.optimizer_source: Reuse WL104F parts_bc.optimizer verbatim, Adam default betas in float32, all 12000 steps. Both starts and terminal scores are stored. Choose each material/arm terminal by its own original-data objective. No rescue fit.

response.precision: Use WL104D Amendment 1 archived reference and original half-split precision gate, same ten incident angles, two azimuths, core/shoulder/tail regions, physical certification, nine materials. Report each angle including 20/50/60 and grazing, per-arm/cohort median and worst, both halves, absolute and signed directional albedo.
response.practical_rule: Relative to R0, pooled mean el1 gain at least 0.005 on both independent halves in each cohort, majority of materials positive in each cohort on both halves, no per-material mean el1 regression >0.01, ealb >0.008, and no grazing eshape regression >0.02. Apply same rule to R2 vs R1 for objective evidence and R1 vs R0 for optimization evidence.

scene.selection: First unrendered WL104F held-out scene, same WL104D held-out camera. One fallback is predeclared, first block scene under L2, only for pre-candidate R0/reference precision failure on the selected held-out scene. Report every attempted reference. No iid_0 scenes.
scene.fixed_intervention: WL104F cross at first hit with native R0 proposal and R0 terminal N2, evaluating R0/R1/R2. Use actual PDF. For descriptive recombined TOTAL use native candidate direct E1, fixed-proposal E2, frozen R0 HIGH. Native comparison evaluates each candidate at all hits.
scene.decision: For each contrast report paired delete-one 95% intervals. Practical recovery requires response rule, primary and held-out native TOTAL gains reaching their respective practical margins with positive 95% lower bounds, and improvement in the joint E1+E2 squared component error (sqrt of E1 RMS squared plus E2 RMS squared) on both with positive 95% lower bounds. Require no point regression exceeding 0.005 on objects E1/E2/TOTAL in any scene or 0.01 in absolute signed ROI biases. Assess R2-R1 and R1-R0 separately with the same plan, retaining null and adverse outcomes. Fixed-proposal results are attribution evidence only.
